compiled_state.title: [Tests]: ticket create dual-output not handled in 12 test files -> 92 CI failures in Script Tests
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
CI failing: Script Tests check fails with 127 failures across 14 test files on PR #25.

Root cause: Epic 3e74-56da changed ticket-create.sh to emit dual-output stdout (human summary + canonical ID on last line). Twelve test files capture ticket create output without | tail -1, so the ticket ID variable receives the full two-line string instead of just the ID. All downstream directory lookups and ticket operations then fail because they use the corrupted ticket ID as a path.

## Files affected
- tests/scripts/test-ticket-comment.sh — _create_ticket() helper at line 43 returns full stdout
- tests/scripts/test-ticket-list.sh — _create_ticket() helper at line 42 returns full stdout
- tests/scripts/test-ticket-reducer-batch.sh — _create_ticket() helper at line 42 returns full stdout
- tests/scripts/test-ticket-transition.sh — _create_ticket() helper + direct captures (35 failures)
- tests/scripts/test-ticket-e2e.sh — multiple direct captures (19 failures)
- tests/scripts/test-ticket-list-transition-comment-e2e.sh — multiple direct captures (16 failures)
- tests/scripts/test-ticket-show.sh — multiple direct captures (13 failures)
- tests/scripts/test-ticket-autoinit.sh — stdout_out capture (1 failure)
- tests/scripts/test-bridge-observability-e2e.sh — line 162 (14 failures)
- tests/scripts/test-bug-report-cli-validation.sh — multiple captures (3 failures)
- tests/scripts/test-bug-report-integration.sh — multiple captures (2 failures)
- tests/scripts/test-plugin-scripts-no-relative-paths.sh — different bug (1 failure)

## Fix
Add | tail -1 to all ticket create output captures in the _create_ticket() helpers and all direct inline captures across the 12 affected test files.

comments.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 2 (BASIC). ROOT_CAUSE confirmed (high confidence): ticket-create.sh lines 266-267 emit dual-output stdout but 12 test files capture ticket create output without | tail -1. Three _create_ticket() helpers return echo "$out" without filtering; 8 files use bare subshell captures; test-ticket-autoinit.sh additionally uses a full-stdout regex that cannot match two-line output. Fix: add | tail -1 to all captures and fix autoinit regex.
